```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(truncnorm)
```

```{r Prep_Data}
# Training data: Filter this to the experiments/wells used to fit the model
paramecium_data <- read_csv("data/sdm_data.csv") |>
  select(particles = avg_particles,
         well,
         experiment,
         timestep,
         conc = conc_correct,
         temp = mean_temp_all) |>
  filter(experiment %in% c("sdm1", "sdm2")) |>
  mutate(well = paste0(well,experiment)) |>
  mutate(well = as.numeric(fct(as.character(well))))
# Filter to timesteps of interest
paramecium_counts <- paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep, conc, temp) |>
  filter(timestep %in% 27:57) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) 

n0_vals <- paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) |>
  filter(timestep == 0) |>
  pull(particles)

equil_vals <- paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) |>
  filter(timestep %in% 27:55) |>
  summarise(particles = median(particles), .by = well) |>
  pull(particles)

well_details <- paramecium_data |>
  select(well, conc, temp) |>
  distinct()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Predict data: filter this to the experiments/wells used to fit the model
pred_paramecium_data <- read_csv("data/sdm_data.csv") |>
  select(particles = avg_particles,
         well,
         experiment,
         timestep,
         conc = conc_correct,
         temp = mean_temp_all) |>
  filter(experiment == "sdm4") |>
  mutate(well = paste0(well, experiment)) |>
  mutate(well = as.numeric(fct(as.character(well))))

# Filter to timesteps of interest
pred_paramecium_counts <- pred_paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep, conc, temp) |>
  filter(timestep %in% 27:57) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) 

pred_n0_vals <- pred_paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) |>
  filter(timestep == 0) |>
  pull(particles)

pred_well_details <- pred_paramecium_data |>
  select(well, conc, temp) |>
  distinct()


# Combine into model list --------------------------------------
model_data <- list(particles = paramecium_counts$particles+1.001,
                   equil_particles = equil_vals+1.001,
                   n0 = n0_vals,
                   temp = well_details$temp,
                   conc = well_details$conc,
                   timestep = paramecium_counts$timestep,
                   well_i = paramecium_counts$well,
                   well = nrow(well_details),
                   N_obs = nrow(paramecium_counts),
                   # Prediction data ------- 
                   n0_tilde = pred_n0_vals,
                   temp_tilde = pred_well_details$temp,
                   conc_tilde = pred_well_details$conc,
                   timestep_tilde = pred_paramecium_counts$timestep,
                   well_i_tilde = pred_paramecium_counts$well,
                   well_tilde = nrow(pred_well_details),
                   N_obs_tilde = nrow(pred_paramecium_counts))
```

```{r GrowthModel}
growthModel <- "
  data {
    // Training data
    int<lower=1> N_obs;
    int<lower=1> well;
    vector[well] conc;
    vector[well] temp;
    array[N_obs] int<lower=1> well_i;
    array[N_obs] int<lower=1> timestep;
    vector<lower=1>[N_obs] particles;
    vector<lower=1>[well] equil_particles;
    vector<lower=1>[well] n0;
  }
  
  // Normalise temperatures for both training data & prediction
  transformed data {
    # Training data
    vector[well] temp_norm = temp-24;
  }
  
  parameters {
    // Fitting parameters
    vector<lower=0.00001, upper = 1000000>[well] K;
    vector<lower=0, upper = 10>[well] r;
    real<lower=0.001, upper = 10> sigma_k;
    real<lower=0.001, upper = 5> sd_r;
    real<lower=0.001, upper = 10> sigma_particles;
    real<lower=0,upper = 10> a_r;
    real<lower=0,upper = 10> a_conc;
    real<lower=5,upper = 20> b_conc;
    real<lower=-10,upper=10> b_temp;
    real<lower=-10,upper=10> b_temp2;
    real<lower=0,upper=1> fail_rate;
  }
  
  transformed parameters {
    // Estimated K/r for training data
    vector<lower=1.00001,upper=1000000>[well] k_mu = (exp(a_conc+b_conc*conc));
    vector<lower=-10000,upper=10000>[well] r_mu = a_r+(b_temp*temp_norm)+(b_temp2*(temp_norm^2));
  }
  
  model {
    vector[N_obs] mu_particles;
    vector[well] mu_particles_equil;
    
    // Priors
    sigma_k ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    sd_r ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    sigma_particles ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    a_r ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    a_conc ~ uniform(0, 10);
    b_conc ~ normal(12, 6) T[5,20];
    b_temp ~ normal(0, 2.5);
    b_temp2 ~ normal(0, 2.5);
    fail_rate ~ uniform(0, 1); 
    
    // Carrying capacity/growth rate for training wells
    for (j in 1:well){
      K[j] ~ lognormal(log(k_mu[j]), sigma_k) T[0.0001,];
      r[j] ~ normal(r_mu[j], sd_r) T[0,];
      mu_particles_equil[j] = K[j]/(1+((K[j]-n0[j])/n0[j])*exp(-1*r[j]*30));
    }
    
    // Estimated number of particles for training wells
    for (i in 1:N_obs){
      mu_particles[i] = K[well_i[i]]/(1+((K[well_i[i]]-n0[well_i[i]])/n0[well_i[i]])*exp(-1*r[well_i[i]]*timestep[i]));
      
      if (equil_particles[well_i[i]] < 0.1*mu_particles_equil[well_i[i]]){
        target += log(fail_rate);
      } else {
        target += log1m(fail_rate);
        particles[i] ~ lognormal(log(mu_particles[i]+1.001), sigma_particles);
      }
    }
  }
"
```

```{r InitsFunction}
makeInits <- function(model_data){
  
  # Parameter starting values
  outList <- list(sigma_particles = 0.1,
                  sd_r = 0.5, 
                  sigma_k = 0.1,
                  a_r = 1, 
                  a_conc = 0.1,
                  b_conc = 12,
                  b_temp = -.01,
                  b_temp2 = -.01)
  
  # Starting values
  simData <- data.frame(well = 1:model_data$well,
                        temp = model_data$temp-24,
                        conc = model_data$conc) |>
    mutate(K = (exp(outList$a_conc+conc*outList$b_conc)),
           r = outList$a_r +
             (outList$b_temp*temp) +
             (outList$b_temp2*(temp^2))) |>
    mutate(r = if_else(r < 0, 0, r))
  
  # Create starting values for prediction data too
  simData_tilde <- data.frame(well = 1:model_data$well_tilde,
                              temp_tilde = model_data$temp_tilde-24,
                              conc_tilde = model_data$conc_tilde) |>
    mutate(K_tilde = (exp(outList$a_conc+conc_tilde*outList$b_conc)),
           r_tilde = outList$a_r +
             (outList$b_temp*temp_tilde) +
             (outList$b_temp2*(temp_tilde^2))) |>
    mutate(r_tilde = if_else(r_tilde < 0, 0, r_tilde))
  
  outList$failure <- rep(0, model_data$well)
  outList$failure_tilde <- rep(0, model_data$well_tilde)
  outList$fail_rate <- 0.01
  outList$r <- simData$r
  outList$K <- simData$K
  outList$r_mu <- simData$r
  outList$K_mu <- simData$K
  outList$r_tilde <- simData_tilde$r_tilde
  outList$K_tilde <- simData_tilde$K_tilde
  outList$r_mu_tilde <- simData_tilde$r_tilde
  outList$K_mu_tilde <- simData_tilde$K_tilde
  return(outList)
}

```

```{r RunModel}
growthModel_fit <- stan(
  model_code = growthModel,
  data = model_data,
  init = list(makeInits(model_data),
              makeInits(model_data),
              makeInits(model_data),
              makeInits(model_data)),
  chains = 4,
  warmup = 500,
  iter = 1500,
  cores = 4,
  refresh = 500
)
  
  
write_rds(growthModel_fit, "outputs/stan_model.rds")
```
